body:
I was hoping to fly into outer space. Go to the heavens and see something that was born of god ( not literally but equivocally).
The shrooms I took didn't make me hallucinate and I wasn't entertained enough to have a good time.
On a very important side note, well several actually; I have anxiety, disconnection issues, self hatred, and a yearning for things I know not of.
Although my trip wasn't what I expected, it wasn't traumatizing. Now that I am not afraid of the mushrooms I can try again.
On the other hand, acid... I'll have to wait a while until I can brace myself with that.
